answer: Work slots are claimed like ferrous veins in a canyon: an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its expected 20-epoch earnings to open one slot, and the burn is final. Opening 100 fake slots costs 100 deposits, while one honest agent pays a single deposit and keeps undiluted slot rewards. Each burned slot is stamped umber on the public ledger, so rented or recycled claims stand out, and any slot failing a spot check loses its deposit too.
